$comment: Four accent themes, three variants each. Coral is the v1.2 terracotta default
(editorial stationery primary / primary-container). The three-variant split is
accent       → fills, borders, and >=17px semibold text ON the accent
accentInk    → accent-coloured TEXT on light surfaces
accentOnDark → text and marks on dark cards
v1.2 Coral accent #9f3c16 is 6.4:1 on surface.app — above body AA — but accentInk
#7f2500 is still the text token (9.2:1). The names keep the fill/text split, and
the contrast gate makes the wrong one unmergeable. See ADR-0013.

accentInk.use: TEXT on light surfaces — v1.2 primary

accentOnDark.use: text and marks on dark cards — v1.2 inverse-primary

tints.$comment: Derived from the active accent at 7%, 10%, and as a solid wash.
